text: Chapter 10: The Lost God's Ship@The Witch in the Woods
■Next Mission\nMove from Rokoko City Ruins to Nezim Wetlands to start.
There are so many monsters and you need to defeat them with\nFragrant Gravels. Go to the Witch's Woods to collect them!
Explore the woods in which a witch is said to have lived for\na long time way before the Cataclysm happened and collect\nFragrant Gravels as you defeat the monsters!
Get rid of the monster that Rita, the witch who lives in the\nwoods, said to have appeared out of nowhere in the depths of\nthe woods!
Go to inform Rita that you have defeated the monster in the\ndepths of the woods!
[[N]]Go to the Witch's House in Witch's Woods
